documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30 September 2026 And Others

analysis.summary: MSTC Limited reported its highest ever Q2 and H1 performance since listing, driven by steady growth in its e-commerce platforms, hardening scrap rates, and increased iron ore volumes. The company received in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India to establish a TReDS platform and is currently evaluating the feasibility of setting up coal and mineral exchanges. Management reiterated its aspiration for double-digit revenue growth while highlighting that its joint venture, MMRPL, turned profitable in H1 FY27 after historical losses. MSTC Limited reported its operational and financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, highlighting growth in standalone and consolidated profits and revenues. During 2026-27-H1, the company crossed INR 545.80 billion in goods transacted through its e-commerce vertical and completed its exit from the legacy trading business.

guidance.claim: MSTC maintains an ongoing double-digit growth aspiration for its business.
guidance.quote: Look, I am basically a very conservative kind of person. So I would always say that double-digit growth aspiration is what we always have.

guidance.claim: Management aims to maintain a double-digit growth average over the long run.
guidance.quote: So, our aim is to maintain a double-digit number.

demand_outlook.claim: Iron ore volumes traded through MSTC platforms registered a growth of more than 10% to 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: I would not have those figures readily available. But yes, there was, in fact, a significant increase, of more than -- definitely more than 10% to 15% there.

demand_outlook.claim: Scrap rates experienced quarter-on-quarter increases of 8% to 10% over the last two quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: It's not been that much. It has been, in fact, maybe 8% to 10% quarter-on-quarter increases. Scrap rates have also increased.

demand_outlook.claim: MSTC processed gross merchandise value of INR 545.80 billion through its portal during H1, excluding trading business.
demand_outlook.quote: During the H1, the total gross merchandise value that has passed through our portal is INR545.80 billion, and basically it is excluding the trading business this we have, MSTC has finally exited as promised earlier also that it will go to the very risk-free zone.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the positive trend in the joint venture MMRPL to strengthen and continue.
demand_outlook.quote: And we expect this trend to strengthen and continue, driving towards a healthy financial outlook for this company.

capex_expansion.claim: MSTC received in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India to establish a Trade Receivable Discounting System (TReDS) platform.
capex_expansion.quote: Meanwhile, we have been working on developing a TReDS, a Trade Receivable Discounting System platform. I am happy to inform you that the in-principle approval has been received from the Reserve Bank of India the day before yesterday, of course subject to fulfilling certain conditions and audits.

capex_expansion.claim: Development of the B2C segment of MSTC's travel portal is expected to take another 3 to 6 months.
capex_expansion.quote: It is likely to take another 3 to 6 months for the portal -- for the B2C part of the portal to come out in the form that we would like it to be.

capex_expansion.claim: MSTC is developing a TReDS platform and has applied to RBI for requisite clearance.
capex_expansion.quote: • MSTC is developing a TReDS platform and has applied to RBI for requisite clearance.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone revenue from operations grew by over 25% year-on-year for H1, while PAT and PBT grew by nearly 42%.
margins_costs.quote: Now, revenue from operation for MSTC increased by more than 25% on year on year for H1, and the PAT and PBT numbers for the same comparison period were higher by nearly 42%.

margins_costs.claim: Total overhead expenses increased by 12.78% to INR 79.14 crores during H1 compared to INR 70.17 crores in the previous year's H1.
margins_costs.quote: And the total overhead, total expenses stands at INR79.14 crores as compared to INR70.17 crores as an increase of only 12.78%, whereas revenue has grown by 31.25%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA percentage of total income was 69.05%, which is nearly 3% higher than the corresponding period of FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA percentage of total income was 69.05%, also nearly 3% higher than the corresponding period of FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Total expenses increased by 16% due to normal salary increases and inflationary pressure.
margins_costs.quote: So, it is generally a normal increase due to increase in the salaries and wages, normal salary wages and inflationary pressure.

orders_capacity.claim: MSTC facilitated liquor license auctions for Karnataka yielding INR 125 crores and land parcel auctions for Telangana realizing INR 2,863 crores during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So during the quarter, liquor license auctions were held for the Government of Karnataka, resulting in revenue of approximately INR125 crores for the state. INR2,863 crores was realized for the State of Telangana through successful land parcel auction.

orders_capacity.claim: MSTC sold nearly 4 lakh metric tons of chromite and 1.54 million metric tons of iron ore/coal during Q2.
orders_capacity.quote: Apart from nearly 4 lakh metric tons of chromite and 1.54 million metric tons of Iron ore/Coal has also been sold through MSTC platform during this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: MSTC executed the first coal gasification event on behalf of the Ministry of Coal.
orders_capacity.quote: Apart from ongoing coal linkage auctions, we conducted the first coal gasification event on behalf of the Ministry of Coal.

orders_capacity.claim: The company won the contract with Coal India for coal linkage auctions and the first batch is underway.
orders_capacity.quote: Then we have also we had informed the stakeholders last time that we have won the contract with Coal India for coal linkage auctions. So, the first batch of auctions for the same is underway right now and it is expected to be extended to other sectors.

capital_allocation.claim: MSTC's cash and cash equivalents generally hover around INR 900 crores to INR 1,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So it is basically a temporary phenomena. And generally, it remains around -- our cash position remains around -- hovering around INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores cash and cash equivalent.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has completely exited from the trading and marketing segment and recovered its dues on the 110% BG model.
capital_allocation.quote: We had taken a decision in FY26 to completely exit from the trading and marketing segment and have seamlessly recovered our dues on the 110% BG model, closing the chapter on this legacy segment in this quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operationalization of proposed coal exchanges is expected to take 3 to 5 years.
risks_headwinds.quote: Pritesh, at this point of time, even setting up the coal exchange, the operational rules, all of that is going to take a little time. So we estimate about 3 to 5 years before those exchanges are actually effectively operational in its full stream.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operational go-ahead for the EPR trading platform remains delayed pending regulatory approvals and stakeholder consultations.
risks_headwinds.quote: So Shashwat, as I, in fact, mentioned during the first question to Naman, regulatory approval is still awaited and stakeholder consultations are still being done by the Ministry and the CPCB.

risks_headwinds.claim: Scrap sales and the steel sector are cyclical, causing rates and volumes to fluctuate.
risks_headwinds.quote: But scrap has always been a cyclical thing. The steel sector as such is very cyclical. So, the rates keep going up and down. And the volume of scrap, that also keeps changing from time to time.

management_commitments.claim: MSTC expects its TReDS platform to stabilize and contribute meaningfully to revenues over the next two fiscals.
management_commitments.quote: So subsequent to this, operations on the platform could start on receipt of final authorization, and we are hopeful that this will be a healthy addition to our revenue stream when the platform stabilizes, which should happen over the next 2 fiscals.

management_commitments.claim: MSTC is in the process of examining the feasibility of setting up Coal & other Mineral exchanges.
management_commitments.quote:
• MSTC is in the process of examining the feasibility of setting up Coal & other
Future Mineral exchanges.

management_commitments.claim: MSTC is developing a TReDS platform and has applied to RBI for requisite clearance.
management_commitments.quote: • MSTC is developing a TReDS platform and has applied to RBI for requisite clearance.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to operationalize the TReDS platform sometime during FY27, subject to regulatory approvals.
management_commitments.quote: This project is also at an advanced stage and subject to regulatory approvals being obtained, we should be able to operationalize this sometime during this FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The internal target is to hopefully get RBI approval and operationalize the TReDS platform within FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So, our internal target is hopefully FY27, within FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
